lines: Ab kooch karo, is shahr mein ji ko lagana kya
couplets.en: Move on now, why let your heart settle in this city?

lines: Wehshi ko sukoon se kya matlab
couplets.en: What has a restless soul to do with peace?

lines: Jogi ka nagar mein thikana kya
couplets.en: What home could a wanderer have in the city?

lines: Insha ji utho, ab kooch karo
couplets.en: Rise, Insha ji, it is time to move on.
